name: BlindCon Venteira 2026
information: Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindConVenteira2026#68543-informacao-importante-important-information), *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindConVenteira2026#68544-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Se és associado da APS tens direito a um **desconto exclusivo de 10%**, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindConVenteira2026#68547-associados-aps-aps-associatess). • If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindConVenteira2026#68543-informacao-importante-important-information), the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindConVenteira2026#68544-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an **exclusive 10% discount**, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BlindConVenteira2026#68547-associados-aps-aps-associates). • **Espetadores podem assistir gratuitamente! | Spectators may attend for free!** **Os convidados não podem permanecer na área de competição enquanto os competidores estiverem a competir. | The guests will not be allowed in the competition area while the competitors are competing.**
